{{Quote|Never seen mind influence in action before, sir. Thank you.|CSF pilot to Jedi Bardan Jusik after the Jedi helped clear the crowds|<ref name="RCTZ" />}}
The '''Coruscant Security Force incident support vessel''' was an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] utilized by the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The support vessel would be activated with a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for crowd control and various other support actions at major [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] operations and incidents.<ref name="RCTZ" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> a support vessel was present at the investigation of an [[Depot Bravo Five terrorist attack|explosion]] of [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] [[Depot Bravo Five]].<ref name="RCTZ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Coruscant Security Force incident support vessel appeared in ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', a novel by [[Karen Traviss]] that was published in [[2006]].<ref name="RCTZ" />
